# oblique_team_owner (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing team ownership assignment by its resource name. The
# name has the form teams/<team>/owners/<owner>.
data "oblique_team_owner" "janedoe_engineering" {
  name = "teams/engineering/owners/janedoe"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the membership. Memberships are always child API objects of a given team. The "{owner}" component is an arbitrary identifier, and doesn't correspond to the actual member.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID is a computed type that always matches 'name'.
- `management` (Attributes) How this ownership is managed. Inherited from the parent team: owners of Terraform-managed teams are themselves Terraform managed and can only be created, updated, or deleted through the Terraform provider; manage the parent team to change this. Omitted from responses when the parent team is manually managed (the default). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--management))
- `owner` (String) The name of the owner. This can be a user, team, or group.

Format: `users/{user}`, `teams/{team}`, `groups/{group}`
- `update_time` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--management"></a>
### Nested Schema for `management`

Read-Only:

- `manager` (String) How the API object is managed. Set automatically by the server based on the caller: Terraform clients produce `TERRAFORM`; for all other clients the management field is left unset on the response.
- `repo_dir` (String) Optionally, the subdirectory within `repo_uri` that holds the Terraform configuration for this API object. Populated by the Oblique Terraform provider.
- `repo_uri` (String) URI of the VCS repository that holds the Terraform configuration for this API object. Populated by the Oblique Terraform provider.
